scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and self-review; not independently audited or externally certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact, noiseless scalar mean-FPT measurements required; numerical inversion may be ill-conditioned.
Original physical positions modulo reflection cannot be identified; only folded reset-site law.
Known circle circumference, Brownian diffusivity and identical independent initial/reset distributions assumed.
title: Sharp arbitrary-rate tomography of random reset sites on a Brownian ring
